bottlenecks.fact: N05 source role cap16 per venue per UTC day is explicitly coded; this is not the exchange public API limit.
Five calls per external collector are shared by all venues, metadata, pagination and optional baseline; first-success early return removed PR311.
Public ticker listing alone cannot prove token chain/address equality. Binance20 is our qualified native registry, not Binance's complete coin listing.
Latest100/1000 trade pages, incomplete minute grids, stale candles and ambiguous duplicate IDs cannot establish a full240-minute N05 window.
Native taker buy/sell candles are usable for aggregate flow; they do not establish whale-sized individual trades, verified exchange deposits/withdrawals or calibrated forecast.

official_primary_documentation.fact: Public requests require no authentication; documented market API rate limits are independent of our16/day role cap.
Native minute candles contain buyTakerAmount, buyTakerQuantity and tradeCount; symbols are queried individually.
Native kline stream carries closed flag, native count, total quote and buy taker quote volume; persistent transport deployment and measured accounting are not yet qualified in this package.

capacity_arithmetic.assumption: One call per symbol with existing valid identity/market metadata and no pagination; no guarantee every venue lists all104.
capacity_arithmetic.conclusion: The fixed16/day role cap cannot support frequent full-universe REST collection even on an ideal native-candle source. Cache/metadata reuse helps, but does not create a fresh rolling window for every asset.
